question: Who was the Greek envoy who visited the Mauryan capital Pataliputra and whose account is a key source for the Mauryan period?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Megasthenes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Megasthenes** was a **Greek envoy** who visited the Mauryan capital **Pataliputra** during the reign of **Chandragupta Maurya**.
 
• He served as an ambassador of **Seleucus I Nicator**, a successor of Alexander the Great, to the Mauryan court.
 
• Megasthenes is known for his detailed account of the Mauryan empire in his work titled **Indica**.
